subject: [PATCH v2 4/4] selftests/mm: check split results by position, drop gather_folio_orders()

2026-10-09.patch_summary: This patch updates the split_huge_page_test to check the results of a split by position, rather than just counting folios of each order in the range. It achieves this by checking the positions of each PMD-sized part of the range after a non-uniform split. The patch also removes the last user of gather_folio_orders and modifies is_backed_by_folio to use cached descriptors instead.
